description: A content section from the copy family as data: kicker, heading and standfirst; blocks of lines (prose, a maker, a list of what it means, a closing line, the trades statement, the partner entries); every line a copy slot; a [P] claim holds its line until Mark closes the row; a partner renders only its publishable fields with consent and a review date. The held-line count is a reading on the page.
